# Ship Kit

> The launch check for Claude Code. Ship Kit finds what will hurt an indie maker's launch, with the file and line for each fix, and Pro writes posts that don't read like AI. It reads your repo and your page (live or local), then writes what a launch needs: a scored pre-flight check, a landing page, posts in your voice checked against each platform's rules, a dated run sheet and a recap. It never posts for you. Tagline: nothing broken on launch day.

## Commands

- /shipkit:check (free): a scored launch pre-flight of 31 items across trust (including leaked API keys, a public .env and a broken or test-mode checkout), the first five seconds (including the share preview: the OG image's real type, pixel size, shape and file weight, and leftover template text), the offer, measurement, distribution, findability and launch week, with the evidence and the fix for each, a 1200×630 score card for that run, and mock-ups of the link's preview on X, iMessage, LinkedIn, Slack and Discord. It works on a live URL or on the local page source before it's deployed, and on private repos: it runs in the maker's own Claude Code and has no server.
- /shipkit:page (free): a one-file landing page from the repo, with the share image, llms.txt and sitemap. It runs the check's probe on its own output.
- /shipkit:lint (free): checks any launch post with a linter for AI tells, an independent critic and the target platform's dated rules.
- /shipkit:posts (Pro): X, Reddit, Show HN, Product Hunt, directory and personal-message drafts in the maker's voice.
- /shipkit:seo (Pro): one keyword-researched page a week, with a QA pass.
- /shipkit:launch (Pro): all of the above plus a dated run sheet, UTM links, a directory plan, a tracker and a launch kit page.
- /shipkit:recap (Pro): launch totals from the tracker, listing checks, a results post and a receipts card image.
- /shipkit:outreach (Pro): finds up to 20 real people from their recent public posts and writes one personal message and follow-up for each. The maker sends them.
- /shipkit:today (Pro): the launch morning brief: what goes out today, at what time, with every word ready to paste, plus a check that the live site and its share preview still work from the day before launch to the day after.

## Launch Check (free web tool)

[Launch Check](https://shipkit.tech/check): paste a URL and get a 0–100 launch score in about 10 seconds. It checks the share preview image and X card, title and description, a visible price, a way to try or buy, noindex, robots.txt rules for search and AI bots, the phone viewport, analytics, a custom domain and a contact link, with a fix for each problem, and a score card image to download. No sign-up.

## Price

Free edition: MIT licensed on GitHub. Pro: one payment of $9 for the first 25 copies, then $19 for the next 50, then $29. Studio: $69 for five people. 14-day refund.

## Requirements

Claude Code on any plan and Node 18 or newer. No other paid services.
